summary: Iter 22 — Frontend-only review of Default-Sheet preview modal + BoundarySetup compact toolbar. Setup wizard partially walked (Identity OK, PIN entry on step 3 of 5 stuck due to focus/hidden-input handling; could not reach /templates live). Findings derived from source-level review of /app/frontend/src/pages/TemplateSetup.jsx, /app/frontend/src/components/app/BoundarySetup.jsx, /app/frontend/src/components/app/TripSheetPreview.jsx + 2 confirmed live navigation runs. CRITICAL: the default-preview modal flow is broken — `handlePickDefault` still navigates straight to /dashboard and never opens the modal; AND `handleConfirmDefault` (referenced at line 230 in TemplateSetup.jsx) is undefined which would throw a ReferenceError if the modal ever opened. SECONDARY ISSUE: the BoundarySetup component (with the new compact toolbar + grid analyzer) is fully implemented but NOT wired into the upload flow — TemplateSetup.jsx renders its own inline UploadView (lines 346-503) which still has the OLD layout (upload-reset/upload-analyze/upload-set on a 3-col grid + the old <dl> Stat report) and BoundarySetup is not imported. So all 4 spec changes (3 BoundarySetup-toolbar items + 1 default-preview modal) regress at runtime even though BoundarySetup.jsx itself is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking [data-testid=pick-default] navigates straight to /dashboard. It must call setShowDefaultPreview(true) so [data-testid=default-preview-modal] opens. Modal flow #4 in spec is completely broken at runtime.

handleConfirmDefault is referenced at line 230 (`<DefaultPreviewDialog onCancel={...} onConfirm={handleConfirmDefault} />`) but is never declared anywhere in the file. If/when handlePickDefault is fixed to open the modal, clicking Confirm will throw 'ReferenceError: handleConfirmDefault is not defined'. The expected impl: setActiveTemplateId(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_ID) → setShowDefaultPreview(false) → toast.success → navigate('/dashboard').

The 3-button [data-testid=upload-controls] toolbar with upload-reset / upload-analyze / upload-set in a 3-col grid is still the active rendered toolbar for view==='upload'. The spec change #1-#3 (compact h-8 4-button toolbar with boundary-analyze-grid + chip-strip report) is in BoundarySetup.jsx but BoundarySetup is NOT imported or rendered anywhere in TemplateSetup.jsx. The inline analysis card (line 458) is still the old <dl> with Stat rows (Font/Size/Thickness only) — no grid chips, no compact strip. Fix: replace UploadView's controls + analysis block with the BoundarySetup component (or wire BoundarySetup as a separate view between 'upload' and 'map').

issues: BoundarySetup line 82 calls `toast.success('No grid pattern detected')` for the negative path — that's a success-styled (green) toast for a failure outcome. Use toast.info or toast.warning to match user expectation.

Add the missing handleConfirmDefault function in TemplateSetup.jsx — body: `await setActiveTemplateId(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE_ID); setShowDefaultPreview(false); toast.success('Using TripMonitor default sheet'); navigate('/dashboard');`

Wire BoundarySetup component into TemplateSetup.jsx upload flow. Either import BoundarySetup and add a new `view==='boundary'` step (advance to it after scan loads, replace the inline UploadView controls/analysis), OR replace UploadView's [data-testid=upload-controls] block + [data-testid=upload-analysis-card] block with the new toolbar+chip-strip layout matching BoundarySetup.jsx. The new boundary-* testids must be reachable from /templates → pick-scan → upload scan in the live DOM.

Consider switching the 'No grid pattern detected' toast to toast.info / toast.warning instead of toast.success.

rca of the issue: Root cause #1 (modal): handlePickDefault was never updated when the new requirement landed — it still has the pre-spec body that navigates to /dashboard immediately. The new state `showDefaultPreview` was declared but never wired to a setter call. Root cause #2 (handleConfirmDefault undefined): the developer added the JSX usage of DefaultPreviewDialog (lines 227-232) and defined the dialog component (lines 242-291) but forgot to define the confirm handler in the parent. Root cause #3 (BoundarySetup not wired): BoundarySetup.jsx was created as a standalone module but never imported/rendered in TemplateSetup.jsx; the inline UploadView was left intact and not migrated to the new layout. Reproduction: from any pre-authed device, navigate to /templates and click 'Use TripMonitor Default' — the URL flips to /dashboard with no modal interstitial. Mitigation: see the four action_items above. Lint would have caught the unused setShowDefaultPreview setter and the undefined handleConfirmDefault reference (no-undef).
